title: Research: exclude P112 4,5^9 with quotient parity
body:
## Summary

Exclude the P112 TWOSIDE `(5,5)` weight profile `4,5^9` over every characteristic-zero field, closing PR3169's named quotient-independence handoff.

```text
six quotient images in a four-flat
  six distinct five-piece code kernels in one plane
  six root lines, contradicting the E8 maximum of three
seven images after contracting a prescribed triple
  classes have size at most two, so one is a singleton
  valid four-piece set, support union <=44
fifteen root-simplex edges
  795 <= 9*44 + 5*72 = 756, contradiction
```

Adds only `research/p112-quotient-parity/`, with the proof, exact source pins, finite receipt, registered replay and failure controls. Commit `95b683196950efea6f3d7ac66745e00dba73425e`; canonical-main baseline `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-18999570).

Credit DreamingOfClouds/#3154 at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d` for TWOSIDE and the C5 handoff; Nick Petalas/#3164 at `857384079ab640a949fb7618b7909664d3e737e5` for root-simplex geometry and #3169 at `2dbbd3004b70772cef200e341037c7c05b094fbc` for the specific failed independence step; and the retained E8/P112 decoder lineage. Development and local checking used substantial automated assistance.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the actual profile survives the original BK/BK7 weight filters. The earlier support-only quotient estimate is `44+12=56`, above distance 53.
- **After:** a six-circuit/root-plane restriction and odd-class argument establish a valid quotient set, giving a strict incidence contradiction with margin 39. No stronger coordinate-budget inequality is needed.
- Full replay covers all 3,309,747 five-flats, 7,140 root-plane pairs, 960 reflections and 232 seven-vertex matchings. Fourteen behavioral groups include an independently calculated rational six-circuit fixture, even-parity failure, strict cutoffs and changed-input rejection.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, Python 3.13 read-only Git-free export, applicable Ruff checks and warnings-as-errors source compilation pass locally. All thirteen committed package/input byte comparisons pass. Internal mathematical and artifact reviews found no objection.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-quotient-parity
```

This closes one named piece configuration. Full C5, `C(P112)>=64`, supplier admission and a new kappa remain open. The standard Weyl-chamber theorem is an explicit dependency. Independent human review, proof-kernel verification and hosted CI are separate. The selected frontier remains unchanged; open next questions are recorded in the package.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** research.

One isolated opt-in proof package. Shared code, selected-result records and frozen inputs are unchanged.
